verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents an invoice editor with live preview and branding, and its branding applies to emails sent from Puzzle, so creating and sending invoices is supported. Nothing in the pack shows online payment options on invoices or tracking of when an invoice is viewed or paid. The only payment-related mention is AI-assisted matching of invoices to payments. Missing for 10: online payment acceptance on invoices, viewed/opened tracking, paid-status notifications, independent hands-on corroboration.
